result = result - Pos(set_screw_offset, 0, -thickness / 2 + set_screw_head_depth / 2) * Cylinder(set_screw_head_diameter / 2, set_screw_head_depth)

result = result + tab

slot = Pos(outer_radius + tab_width / 2, 0, 0) * Box(slot_length, slot_width, thickness / 2)
result = result - slot
